requirements.requirement: One authoritative owner and explicit state contract for every material transition
Immediate POS and delivery/on-account paths reuse the same accounting, inventory, receipt, payment and reconciliation kernels
Sale retries replay the original result safely
Provider-owned pending, unknown, captured and settled semantics
Immutable receipt/fiscal source independent of delivery
Inventory quantity and COGS move at the correct physical event
Cash, clearing, AR, revenue, tax, COGS, inventory, fees, refunds and settlement postings balance and are source-linked
Refunds, voids and returns preserve history with compensating evidence
Shift close, statements, reconciliation and accounting close are distinct and observable
Offline events are signed, ordered, replay-safe, conflict-aware and resolvable
Isolation, RBAC, entitlement, fresh auth, redaction, auditability and separation of duties are tested
Local evidence is distinguished from production proof and unresolved blockers remain explicit
